records.jp: メインメニュー内にあるＳＡＶＥ／ＬＯＡＤ^00よりゲームデータのセーブおよびロードを^00行うことができます。^00メインメニューは<IM06>で開きます
records.en_original: Access SAVE/LOAD on the main menu to save or load your game data. You can open the main menu with <IM06>.
records.en_auxiliary: Access SAVE/LOAD on the Main Menu to save or load your game data. You can open the Main Menu with <KEY_ASSIGN_FIELD_MAINMENU>.
records.en: Access SAVE/LOAD on the main menu to save or load your game data. You can open the main menu with <IM06>.

records.jp: スクールマップより、選択した場所へ^00直接移動することができます。^00スクールマップは<IM11>で開きます
records.en_original: You can fast travel by selecting a location from the school map. You can open the school map with <IM11>.
records.en_auxiliary: You can fast travel by selecting a location from the School Map. You can open the School Map with <KEY_ASSIGN_FIELD_SCHOOL_MAP>.
records.en: You can fast travel by selecting a location from the school map. You can open the school map with <IM11>.

records.jp: イベントが発生する場所にはアイコンが^00表示されます。どこへ行くか迷った時は^00アイコンのある場所へ行ってみましょう
records.en_original: Locations with a pending event will be marked with an icon. When you don't know where to go, just go to the icon!
records.en_auxiliary: Locations with a pending event will be marked with an icon. When you don't know where to go, just go to the icon!
records.en: Locations with a pending event will be marked with an icon. When you don't know where to go, just go to the icon!

records.jp: フリスペ！では「テーブルチャット」^00「ジュークボックス」「やみのどうくつ」^00などの機能を使用することができます
records.en_original: You can now access "Table Chat, "Jukebox," <CR>and "Dark Cave" on FreeSpace!
records.en_auxiliary: You can now access Table Chat, Jukebox, <CR>and Dark Cave on FreeSpace!
records.en: You can now access "Table Chat, "Jukebox," <CR>and "Dark Cave" on FreeSpace!

records.jp: フリスペ！は学校にいる間のみ、<IM15>で^00開くことができます
records.en_original: You can only open FreeSpace at school by<CR>pressing <IM15>.
records.en_auxiliary: You can only open FreeSpace! at school by pressing <KEY_ASSIGN_FIELD_FREE_SPACE>.
records.en: You can only open FreeSpace at school by<CR>pressing <IM15>.

records.jp: 「テーブルチャット」では仲間との会話を^00楽しめます。着信がある場合は<IM00>で返信^00しますが、返事を保留にすることもできます
records.en_original: You can chat with your friends via "Table Chat". Respond to messages with <IM00>, or simply decline to respond.
records.en_auxiliary: You can chat with your friends via Table Chat. Respond to messages with <KEY_ASSIGN_BASIC_OK>, or simply decline to respond.
records.en: You can chat with your friends via "Table Chat". Respond to messages with <IM00>, or simply decline to respond.

records.jp: また、話のネタを校内の各地で見つけた後、^00テーブルチャット画面で<IM06>を押すと、^00日菜子から話題を振ることもできます
records.en_original: Or you can bring up conversation topics you find on campus by pressing <IM06> on the Table Chat screen.
records.en_auxiliary: Or you can bring up conversation topics you find on campus by pressing <KEY_ASSIGN_BASIC_SUB_MENU> on the Table Chat screen.
records.en: Or you can bring up conversation topics you find on campus by pressing <IM06> on the Table Chat screen.

records.jp: ただし、未読チャットがある場合は^00話のネタを使用できません。^00まずは仲間からのチャットを確認して^00みましょう
records.en_original: However, you can't start a new conversation if you have unread messages. Always check to see what your friends have sent you first.
records.en_auxiliary: However, you can't start a new conversation if you have unread messages. Always check to see what your friends have sent you first.
records.en: However, you can't start a new conversation if you have unread messages. Always check to see what your friends have sent you first.

records.jp: 「ジュークボックス」ではインストールして^00いる楽曲を再生して聴くことができます
records.en_original: The "Jukebox" can play whatever songs you've installed.
records.en_auxiliary: The Jukebox can play whatever songs you've installed.
records.en: The "Jukebox" can play whatever songs you've installed.

records.jp: プレイリストを作成する場合は、^00プレイリストに追加したい楽曲を<IM10>で選んで^00<IM05>を押すとプレイリストに追加されます。^00再び<IM05>を押すとプレイリストから外れます
records.en_original: Creating a playlist is easy. Select the songs that you want to include with <IM10> then press <IM05> to add them. You can press <IM05> to delete songs, too.
records.en_auxiliary: Creating a playlist is easy. Select the songs that you want to include with <IM09>, then press <KEY_ASSIGN_BASIC_FAVORITE> to add them. Press <KEY_ASSIGN_BASIC_FAVORITE> again to remove songs.
records.en: Creating a playlist is easy. Select the songs that you want to include with <IM10> then press <IM05> to add them. You can press <IM05> to delete songs, too.

records.jp: プレイリストに追加している楽曲は、^00曲名の左の音符が点灯しています^00
records.en_original: The musical note next to a song's title will light up if the song is on your playlist.
records.en_auxiliary: The musical note next to a song's title will light up if the song is on your playlist.
records.en: The musical note next to a song's title will light up if the song is on your playlist.

records.jp: 複数の楽曲をプレイリストに加えている^00状態で<IM11><IM15>を押すと、今再生されている^00楽曲から次の楽曲に移ります
records.en_original: When your playlist has a few tracks, you can<CR>press <IM11><IM15> to skip to the next song.
records.en_auxiliary: When your playlist has a few tracks, you can press<CR><KEY_ASSIGN_BASIC_TAB_LEFT><KEY_ASSIGN_BASIC_TAB_RIGHT> to skip to the next song.
records.en: When your playlist has a few tracks, you can<CR>press <IM11><IM15> to skip to the next song.

records.jp: 「やみのどうくつ」は、^00女子高生の間で人気の育成ゲームです。^00魔物を育てて強くすることで、^00巣立った後の結果が変化します
records.en_original: "Dark Cave" is a monster-raising game that's popular with high school girls. Your monsters change and grow depending on how you <CR>treat them.
records.en_auxiliary: Dark Cave is a monster-raising game that's popular with high school girls. Your monsters change and grow depending on how you <CR>treat them.
records.en: "Dark Cave" is a monster-raising game that's popular with high school girls. Your monsters change and grow depending on how you <CR>treat them.

records.jp: ３つの選択肢のうち１つを選んでお世話を^00することで、魔物を育てることができます^00「しあがり」が最大になると、魔物は^00牧場から巣立っていきます
records.en_original: You raise the monster by choosing one of three choices. When "Growth" reaches its maximum the monster will leave the farm.
records.en_auxiliary: You raise the monster by choosing one of three choices. When its Growth reaches its maximum, the monster will leave the farm.
records.en: You raise the monster by choosing one of three choices. When "Growth" reaches its maximum the monster will leave the farm.

records.jp: 一度お世話をしてから一定時間が経過すると^00通知が来て、再び魔物のお世話ができます。^00リフレクター活動の合間に少しずつ^00進めて、最強の魔物を育てましょう！
records.en_original: Once you've tended to a monster, time must pass before you can tend to it again. Try and raise the strongest monster as you unwind between your Reflector duties!
records.en_auxiliary: Once you've tended to a monster, time must pass before you can tend to it again. Try and raise the strongest monster as you unwind between your Reflector duties!
records.en: Once you've tended to a monster, time must pass before you can tend to it again. Try and raise the strongest monster as you unwind between your Reflector duties!

records.jp: メインメニュー内にあるミッションメニュー^00より、現在発生中のミッションの内容を確認^00することができます
records.en_original: You can check your active missions and the descriptions in the mission menu, accessible from the main menu.
records.en_auxiliary: You can check your active missions and their details in the Mission menu, accessible from the Main Menu.
records.en: You can check your active missions and the descriptions in the mission menu, accessible from the main menu.

records.jp: 内容にはミッションの依頼内容と進捗、^00達成時に得られる報酬と評価ｐｔが載って^00います
records.en_original: You can check a mission's progression in its description, as well as the rewards and Rating Points associated with it.
records.en_auxiliary: You can check a mission's progression in its description, as well as the rewards and rating points associated with it.
records.en: You can check a mission's progression in its description, as well as the rewards and Rating Points associated with it.

records.jp: 評価ｐｔを上げることで日菜子に対する^00周りの関心が強まり、フラグメントに関わる^00重要なお話が舞い込むことがあります
records.en_original: The more rating points you have, the more your reputation will increase, improving your chances of hearing about leads on Fragments.
records.en_auxiliary: The more rating points you have, the more your reputation will increase, improving your chances of hearing about leads on Fragments.
records.en: The more rating points you have, the more your reputation will increase, improving your chances of hearing about leads on Fragments.

records.jp: 目標とする評価ｐｔに達したら、ユズか^00ライムに活動を報告できるようになります
records.en_original: When you reach your target number of rating <CR>points, you can report back to Yuzu and Lime about your activities.
records.en_auxiliary: When you reach your target number of rating <CR>points, you can report back to Yuzu and Lime about your activities.
records.en: When you reach your target number of rating <CR>points, you can report back to Yuzu and Lime about your activities.

records.jp: ミッションは全てクリアする必要は^00ありません。可能なミッションを達成し、^00評価ｐｔを上げていきましょう
records.en_original: It's not necessary to complete every mission as long as you acquire enough rating points. Don't worry.
records.en_auxiliary: You don't have to complete every mission. You just need to acquire enough rating points.
records.en: It's not necessary to complete every mission as long as you acquire enough rating points. Don't worry.

records.jp: コモンリープによるミッションは^00フラグメントの暴走を引き起こしている原因^00を解決することで達成することができます
records.en_original: The missions requiring a Common Leap are completed by figuring out what caused a Fragment to go rampant.
records.en_auxiliary: The missions requiring a Common Leap are completed by figuring out what caused a Fragment to go rampant.
records.en: The missions requiring a Common Leap are completed by figuring out what caused a Fragment to go rampant.

records.jp: また、<IM11>でコモンから元の世界へ^00戻ることができます
records.en_original: FYI, you can return to the real world from the Common by pressing <IM11>.
records.en_auxiliary: You can return to the real world from the Common by pressing <KEY_ASSIGN_FIELD_SCHOOL_MAP>.
records.en: FYI, you can return to the real world from the Common by pressing <IM11>.

records.jp: 固定化させたフラグメントは、^00メインメニューのステータス内にある^00ＦＲＡＧＭＥＮＴで着脱を行う事ができます
records.en_original: You can equip a stabilized fragment by going to^00"STATUS" from the main menu and selecting^00"FRAGMENT."
records.en_auxiliary: You can equip a stabilized Fragment by going to Status from the Main Menu and selecting Fragment.
records.en: You can equip a stabilized fragment by going to^00"STATUS" from the main menu and selecting^00"FRAGMENT."

records.jp: フラグメントはリフレクターの３人が^00それぞれ覚えているスキルに対して^00着脱をする事ができます
records.en_original: You can attach Fragments to each Reflector's specific skills.
records.en_auxiliary: You can attach Fragments to each Reflector's specific skills.
records.en: You can attach Fragments to each Reflector's specific skills.

records.jp: 装着されたスキルは、スキル本来の効果に^00加え、フラグメントからの効果がさらに^00適応されるようになります
records.en_original: The equipped skills will have their original effect as well as the effect of the attached Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: The equipped skills will have their original effect as well as the effect of the attached Fragment.
records.en: The equipped skills will have their original effect as well as the effect of the attached Fragment.

records.jp: 装着できる数はスキルごとに決まっており、^00上限内であればいくつでもフラグメントを^00装着する事ができます
records.en_original: You can attach as many Fragments as each skill has slots.
records.en_auxiliary: You can attach as many Fragments as each skill has slots.
records.en: You can attach as many Fragments as each skill has slots.

records.jp: 特定のアイテムを使用することで^00フラグメントを強化することができます。^00強化に必要なアイテムはフラグメントごとに^00それぞれ異なります
records.en_original: Fragments can be reinforced with specific items, though the items vary with each <CR>individual Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Fragments can be reinforced with specific items, though the items vary with each individual Fragment.
records.en: Fragments can be reinforced with specific items, though the items vary with each <CR>individual Fragment.

records.jp: フラグメント強化はアイテム作成と同様に、^00コモンに時々出現する空間で行うことが^00できます
records.en_original: Reinforcing Fragments, like Crafting, can be performed in certain areas throughout <CR>the Common.
records.en_auxiliary: Reinforcing Fragments, like Crafting, can be performed in certain areas throughout <CR>the Common.
records.en: Reinforcing Fragments, like Crafting, can be performed in certain areas throughout <CR>the Common.

records.jp: フラグメントを固定化するなどの特定の^00行動をとった際に、３人は成長ポイントを^00入手する事があります
records.en_original: Some actions, like Fragment stabilization, will reward you with Growth Points for your Reflectors.
records.en_auxiliary: Some actions, like Fragment stabilization, will reward you with Growth Points for your Reflectors.
records.en: Some actions, like Fragment stabilization, will reward you with Growth Points for your Reflectors.

records.jp: 入手した成長ポイントは、メインメニューの^00ステータス内にあるＧＲＯＷＴＨで使用する^00事ができます
records.en_original: Growth points can be used in the Growth menu, accessible through Status on the Main Menu.
records.en_auxiliary: Growth Points can be used in the Growth menu, accessible through Status on the Main Menu.
records.en: Growth points can be used in the Growth menu, accessible through Status on the Main Menu.

records.jp: アタック、ディフェンス、サポート、^00テクニックの４項目があり、好きな項目に^00成長ポイントを割り振る事ができます
records.en_original: You can use a growth point to upgrade a Reflector's Attack, Defense, Support, or Technic.
records.en_auxiliary: You can use a Growth Point to upgrade a Reflector's Attack, Defense, Support, or Technic.
records.en: You can use a growth point to upgrade a Reflector's Attack, Defense, Support, or Technic.

records.jp: １つポイントを振ることで、レベルを１つ^00あげる事ができます。振った項目により、^00上がる基礎パラメータにも変化があります
records.en_original: Using a point to influence a character's stat growth will cause her to level up.
records.en_auxiliary: Using a point to influence a character's stat growth will cause her to level up.
records.en: Using a point to influence a character's stat growth will cause her to level up.

records.jp: 成長ポイントを振っていく事により、条件を^00満たしたスキルを習得する事が出来ます
records.en_original: You can learn skills by using growth points to meet each skill's stat requirement.
records.en_auxiliary: You can learn skills by using Growth Points to meet each skill's stat requirement.
records.en: You can learn skills by using growth points to meet each skill's stat requirement.

records.jp: アタックに振ればより攻撃的なスキル、^00ディフェンスに振れば、回復などの守りに^00特化したスキルを習得します
records.en_original: Focusing on Attack will yield more offensive skills. Defense will yield healing and protective ones.
records.en_auxiliary: Focusing on Attack will yield more offensive skills. Defense will yield healing and protective ones.
records.en: Focusing on Attack will yield more offensive skills. Defense will yield healing and protective ones.

records.jp: サポートに振れば戦闘中の強化スキル、^00テクニックに振れば先述した３種類以外の^00特殊なスキルを習得します
records.en_original: Support will allow you to buff your allies, and Technic will result in unique skills that defy categorization.
records.en_auxiliary: Support will allow you to buff your allies, and Technic will result in unique skills that defy categorization.
records.en: Support will allow you to buff your allies, and Technic will result in unique skills that defy categorization.

records.jp: スキル習得画面で<IM06>を押すと、^00未習得のスキルの詳細を見ることができます
records.en_original: You can look at your unlearned skills by pressing <IM06> on the skill screen.
records.en_auxiliary: You can look at your learnable skills by pressing <KEY_ASSIGN_BASIC_SUB_MENU> on the Skills screen.
records.en: You can look at your unlearned skills by pressing <IM06> on the skill screen.

records.jp: 戦闘はターン制のコマンドバトルです。^00ターンが回ってきたときにコマンドを^00選択します
records.en_original: Your battles are fought in a turn-based, command-choosing fashion. When it's your turn, you choose a command.
records.en_auxiliary: Battles are turn-based and fought by selecting commands. Choose a command when it's your turn.
records.en: Your battles are fought in a turn-based, command-choosing fashion. When it's your turn, you choose a command.

records.jp: <IM10>で選び、<IM00>でコマンドを決定します。^00選択したスキルは実行時に、設定されている^00ＭＰを消費します。ＭＰが足りないとスキル^00を発動することができません
records.en_original: Select a command with <IM10>, then execute it with <IM00>. Skills use a set amount of MP and cannot be used without enough.
records.en_auxiliary: Select a command with <IM10>, then execute it with <KEY_ASSIGN_BASIC_OK>. Skills use a set amount of MP and cannot be used without enough MP.
records.en: Select a command with <IM10>, then execute it with <IM00>. Skills use a set amount of MP and cannot be used without enough.

records.en: You can escape from most battles, but any items you received from beating an enemy in that fight will be lost.

records.en: Status ailments in combat result in the lowering of stats like Attack as well as adverse effects like continual damage.

records.en_auxiliary: Stat debuffs and draining HP are just the start. Other ailments include...
records.en: Stat debuffs and draining HP are just the start. Other ailments include...

records.jp: 混乱：一定時間、自動で行動が選択されます^00暗闇：命中、回避を一時的に下降させます^00麻痺：一定時間、ＴＬの進行を止めます

records.en_auxiliary: Confusion: Selects actions at random. <CR>Blindness: Lowers accuracy and evasion. <CR>Paralysis: Halts timeline progression.
records.en: Confusion: Selects actions at random. <CR>Blindness: Lowers accuracy and evasion. <CR>Paralysis: Halts timeline progression.

records.jp: 状態異常は時間が経過すると消えますが、^00混乱・暗闇・麻痺はスキルによって回復する^00ことができます。能力低下や継続ダメージを^00スキルで回復することはできません

records.en: Status ailments will heal over time, but Confusion, Blindness, Paralysis can be cured with skills. You just have to wait out gradual damage and debuffs.

records.jp: 攻撃中に表示されるコマンドを入力すると^00仲間のスキルを使用することができます

records.en_auxiliary: You can use your Supporters' skills by entering displayed commands during an attack.
records.en: You can use Supporters' skills during your attack commands.

records.jp: スキルの使用には力を蓄える必要があり、^00力は主にターン経過で蓄えられていきます。^00力が蓄え終わるまで攻撃中にコマンドが^00表示されることはないので注意しましょう

records.jp: 仲間の状態は<IM06>で確認できます。^00仲間のＨＰが０になると、恐怖に負けて^00その場から逃げ出してしまいます

records.en: You can check on your friends by pressing <IM06>. When your friend's HP reaches 0, they'll be overwhelmed with fear and run from combat.

records.jp: その間、逃げ出した仲間のスキルは^00使用できなくなりますが、一定時間が^00経過すると仲間は再び戻ってきます
records.en_original: During that time, you will not be able to use that character's skills. Don't worry, though, they'll rejoin the party after a while.
records.en_auxiliary: You can't use the skills of Supporters who have run away, but don't worry, they'll rejoin after a while.
records.en: During that time, you will not be able to use that character's skills. Don't worry, though, they'll rejoin the party after a while.

records.jp: 仲間のスキルが使用可能かどうかは、^00ＭＰの値で確認できます。^00ＭＰが最大の時、スキルを発動できます

records.en_auxiliary: You can check if a character's skill is ready by checking her MP. When it's at max, she can use her skill.
records.en: You can check if a character's skill is ready by checking her MP. When it's at max, she can use her skill.

records.jp: オーバードライブを３回使用した際に^00行動の最後に発動する、日菜子たちの^00協力技です

records.en_auxiliary: When an Overdrive is used three times or more, the Reflectors will combine their powers after the final move and launch a Cooperation Skill attack.
records.en: When an Overdrive is used three times or more, the Reflectors will combine their powers after the final move and launch a "Cooperation Skill" attack.

records.jp: ターンが回ってくるまでの待機時間中、表示^00されるコマンドに対応した<IM10>を入力すると^00アクティブコマンドを使用することが^00できます
records.en_original: If you see an Active Command displayed while waiting for your next turn, you can press <IM10> to use it.
records.en_auxiliary: If you see an Active Command displayed while waiting for your next turn, you can press the displayed button to use it.
records.en: If you see an Active Command displayed while waiting for your next turn, you can press <IM10> to use it.

records.jp: アクティブコマンドを使用するには^00エーテルゲージを消費します。^00効果を得るには【入力し続ける】必要が^00ありますので注意しましょう

records.en_auxiliary: Using an Active Command will consume some of your Ether Gauge. Don't forget, you must continue holding the button for the skill to work.
records.en: Using an Active Command will consume some of your Ether Guage. Don't forget, you need to keep pressing the button for the skill to work.

records.jp: アクティブコマンドは、仲間との絆を深める^00ことで、より強力な効果を発揮するように^00なります

records.en_auxiliary: Active Commands will increase in power and effect as the bonds between your friends deepen.
records.en: Active Commands will increase in power and effect as the bonds between your friends deepen.

records.en_auxiliary: Use the GUARD Active Command by <CR>pressing <KEY_ASSIGN_BATTLE_ACTIVE_COMMAND_GUARD>. The higher your guard rate, the less damage you receive.
records.en: Use the "GUARD" Active Command by <CR>pressing <IM22>. The higher your guard rate, the less damage you receive.

records.jp: ガード率は　相手の攻撃を受けるまで^00蓄積し続けることができます。^00初めはＬｖ０ですが、Ｌｖ１になると^00ガードの効果が強化されます
records.en_original: Your guard rate will increase as you wait for an enemy attack. It starts at Level 0, but when it reaches Level 1, your guard will block more damage.
records.en_auxiliary: Your guard rate will increase as you wait for an enemy attack. It starts at Level 0, but when it reaches Level 1, your guard will block more damage.
records.en: Your guard rate will increase as you wait for an enemy attack. It starts at Level 0, but when it reaches Level 1, your guard will block more damage.

records.en_auxiliary: Damage taken from enemies can be significantly reduced by selecting the GUARD Active Command just before an enemy attacks.
records.en: Damage taken from enemies can be significantly reduced by selecting the "GUARD" Active Command just before an enemy attacks.

records.en_auxiliary: You can Reflect when your guard rate is Level 3. Like Perfect Guard, it's used just before an attack hits, but it also sends damage back at the attacking foe.

records.en: "RECOVERY" can be performed as an Active Command by pressing <IM23>. It recovers HP and MP the moment it's inputted.

records.jp: Ｌｖ０ではＨＰのみですが、Ｌｖ１に^00なるとＭＰも回復するようになります。^00Ｌｖ２ではＨＰ回復が強化され、^00Ｌｖ３ではＭＰ回復も強化されます

records.en_auxiliary: While Level 0 only recovers HP, Level 1 also increases MP. Level 2 increases HP recovery, and Level 3 increases MP recovery.
records.en: While Level 0 only recovers HP, Level 1 also increases MP. Level 2 increases HP recovery, and Level 3 increases MP recovery.

records.en_auxiliary: This command will only appear during a battle with a Sephira. It's activated when all of an enemy's parts are destroyed and their main body's HP is below 1.
records.en: This command will only appear during a battle with a Sephirot. It's activated when all an enemy's parts are destroyed and their main body's HP is below 1.

records.en: Activating the Reflect Counter allows you to defeat a Sephirot.

records.jp: スクールマップでは、^00ミッションの相談者がいる場所は^00上図のようなアイコンで示されます

records.en_auxiliary: Mission clients' locations are marked on the School Map with icons like the one above.
records.en: Mission clients' locations are marked on the School Map with icons like the one above.

records.en_auxiliary: You can add your friends as Supporters for <CR>Hinako, Yuzu, and Lime. You can configure your supporter teams right before a battle with a Sephira.

records.en_auxiliary: You can use the Crafting menu to combine items into tools useful for Common exploration and Fragment reinforcement.
records.en: You can use the Crafting menu to combine items into tools useful for Common exploration and Fragment reinforcement.

records.jp: コモンには未成熟な「想いの欠片」が^00散らばっています。これらは近づいて^00<IM00>で入手することができます

records.en_auxiliary: Monsters in the Common can influence a person's psyche. Running into them will immediately start a battle.
records.en: Demons in the Common can influence a person's psyche. Running into them will immediately start a battle.

records.en_auxiliary: There is a gate that connects to the Common on the rooftop. This will allow you to leap into the Common even when you don't have a mission to complete.
records.en: There is a gate that connects to the Common on the rooftop. This will allow you to leap into the Common even when you don't have a mission to complete.

records.jp: リープ先のゾーンは日によって異なります。^00集めたいアイテムが見つからないときは、^00日を改めてみましょう
records.en_original: You'll leap into a different Zone each day.<CR>If you can't find an item you want, try coming back tomorrow.
records.en_auxiliary: You'll leap into a different zone each day. If you can't find an item you want, try coming back tomorrow.
records.en: You'll leap into a different Zone each day.<CR>If you can't find an item you want, try coming back tomorrow.

records.jp: 屋上のゲートから、コモンの中央ゾーンへ^00行くことができます。中央ゾーンは^00コモンの４つのゾーンと繋がっており、^00各ゾーンへ行くことができます

records.en_auxiliary: You can get to the Common's Central Zone through the gate on the rooftop. The Central Zone is connected to the other four, so you can access other zones as well.
records.en: You can get to the Common's central Zone through the gate on the rooftop. The Central Zone is connected to the other four, so you can access other zones as well.

records.jp: アクティブコマンドが使用可能な時に^00<IM24>で【サポーター保護】が発動し、^00サポーターのＭＰの増加を早め、^00ＨＰを回復することができます

records.en: During the Active Command phase, <CR>press <IM25> for a "TIMELINE" This allows you to speed up your allies' turn and slow down <CR>the enemy's.

records.en: Once the day comes to a close, you can prepare for tomorrow, take a bath, and more.

records.en: Taking a bath lets Hinako reflect on the <CR>day's events. The actions taken at home will influence the happenings at school the next day.

records.jp: 指輪を渡した仲間に話しかけると、^00特殊な会話が発生することがあります
records.en_original: Talking to your friends who have rings can result in special conversations.
records.en_auxiliary: Talking to your friends who have rings can result in special conversations.
records.en: Talking to your friends who have rings can result in special conversations.

records.jp: この会話の中では選択肢が表示される場合が^00あり、選択次第で交友の深まり具合や^00手に入るフラグメントが異なってきます

records.en_auxiliary: These conversations will allow you to choose your response. These choices will determine how your bonds develop, and may even lead to a Fragment.
records.en: These conversations will allow you to choose your response. These choices will determine how your bonds develop, and may even lead to a Fragment.

records.en_original: If you ask a friend out after school, you can deepen your bond with them.
records.en_auxiliary: If you ask a friend out after school, you can deepen your bond with them.
records.en: If you ask a friend out after school, you can deepen your bond with them.

records.jp: 誘った場合は行き先がランダムで決定し、^00その行き先ごとに様々な会話が発生します
records.en_original: If you invite them, you and your friend will go to a random location. Each location will yield a different conversation.
records.en_auxiliary: If you invite them, you and your friend will go to a random location. Each location will yield a different conversation.
records.en: If you invite them, you and your friend will go to a random location. Each location will yield a different conversation.

records.jp: 移動中にはアイテムを使用することが^00できます。戦闘中には使えないので、^00事前にしっかり準備をしておきましょう
records.en_original: Items can be used while exploring, but NOT while you're in combat. Always make sure you're prepared before a battle starts.
records.en_auxiliary: Items can be used while exploring, but not while you're in combat. Always make sure you're prepared before a battle starts.
records.en: Items can be used while exploring, but NOT while you're in combat. Always make sure you're prepared before a battle starts.

records.jp: アイテムには、日菜子たちの^00基礎パラメータを上げるもの、^00一度コモンを入ってから出るまでの間^00日菜子たちを強化するものなどがあります

records.en_auxiliary: Some items will even enhance the party's stats from the time you enter the Common to the time you exit it.
records.en: Some items will even enhance the party's stats from the time you enter the Common to the time you exit it.

records.en_original: "Ako's Journal" is Ako Ichinose's blog chronicling the adventures of Hinako and her fellow Reflectors.
records.en_auxiliary: Ako's Journal is Ako Ichinose's blog chronicling the adventures of Hinako and her fellow Reflectors.
records.en: "Ako's Journal" is Ichinose Ako's blog chronicling the adventures of Hinako and her fellow Reflectors.

records.jp: 日菜子たちの活動が進展するにつれて、^00記事が更新されていきます
records.en_original: New articles will be posted as Hina's exploits continue.
records.en_auxiliary: New articles will be posted as Hina's exploits continue.
records.en: New articles will be posted as Hina's exploits continue.

records.jp: 「かくれんぼ」は、井上千紘が校内の^00各地に置いたぬいぐるみの居場所について^00ヒントを発信するチャンネルです
records.en_original: "Hide and Seek" is a channel run by Chihiro Inoue. It contains hints to the locations of her plushies on campus.

records.en: "Hide and Seek" is a channel run by Inoue Chihiro. It contains hints to the locations of her plushies on campus.

records.jp: 学校生活が進むにつれて^00ぬいぐるみが置かれている場所が変わり、^00場所のヒントも更新されていきます
records.en_original: As your life at school progresses, the location of the plushies will change, and the hints will be updated.
records.en_auxiliary: As your life at school progresses, the location of the plushies will change, and the hints will be updated.
records.en: As your life at school progresses, the location of the plushies will change, and the hints will be updated.

records.en_original: Some locations in the Common cannot be reached with a regular jump. But press <IM00> at a point with a feather effect and you'll leap to your desired spot.
records.en_auxiliary: Some locations in the Common cannot be reached with a regular jump. Press <KEY_ASSIGN_FIELD_ACCESS> at a point with a feather effect and you'll leap to your desired spot.
records.en: Some locations in the Common cannot be reached with a regular jump. But press <IM00> at a point with a feather effect and you'll leap to your desired spot.

records.jp: 探索中に先へ進めなくなったときは、^00羽根のエフェクトがどこかにないか^00探してみましょう
records.en_original: When you feel like you've exhausted your exploration options, try looking for these feather effects.
records.en_auxiliary: When you feel like you've exhausted your exploration options, try looking for these feather effects.
records.en: When you feel like you've exhausted your exploration options, try looking for these feather effects.

records.jp: ＤＬＣなどで手に入れた衣装は、^00更衣室で着替えることができます
records.en_original: You can change into outfits you received from DLC here.
records.en_auxiliary: You can use this to change into outfits you've received.
records.en: You can change into outfits you received from DLC here.

records.jp: 更衣室は３章以降にスクールマップから^00移動することができます
records.en_original: The dressing room can be accessed from the school map after chapter 3.
records.en_auxiliary: The Dressing Room can be accessed from the School Map after Chapter 3.
records.en: The dressing room can be accessed from the school map after chapter 3.

records.jp: 攻撃の属性には、鋭利・衝撃・貫通・心力の^00４属性があります。敵の弱点属性を突くと、^00より大きなダメージを与えられます

records.en_auxiliary: There are 4 types of attacks: Slash, Impact, Pierce, and Heart. Using the attributes an enemy is weak to will deal higher damage to them.
records.en: There are 4 types of attacks: Slash, Impact, Pierce, and Heart. Using the attributes an enemy is weak against will deal higher damage to them.

records.jp: 逆に敵が耐性をもつ属性で攻撃した場合は^00あまりダメージを与えられません
records.en_original: But if you attack with a attribute that a enemy is resistant to, you won't be able to deal them much damage.

records.en: But if you attack with a attribute that a enemy is resistant to, you won't be able to deal them much damage.

records.en_auxiliary: Enemy strengths and weaknesses can be checked on the Enemy page of the Database.
records.en: Enemy strengths and weaknesses can be checked on the Enemy page of the Database.

records.jp: 物語の進行上重要となる場面でコモンに^00来たとき、多くの場合ではフラグメントを^00探すことが目的となります
records.en_original: Your primary reasons for going to the Common will be locating and stablizing Fragments for story purposes.
records.en_auxiliary: Your primary reasons for going to the Common will be locating and stabilizing Fragments for story purposes.
records.en: Your primary reasons for going to the Common will be locating and stablizing Fragments for story purposes.

records.en_original: Picking up "Emotion Shards" and following the trail of emotions will lead you right to a Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Picking up Emotion Shards and following the trail of emotions will lead you right to a Fragment.
records.en: Picking up "Emotion Shards" and following the trail of emotions will lead you right to a Fragment.

records.jp: 「タイムライン（ＴＬ）」には、味方と^00敵の行動順が示されています。味方は左から^00中央、敵は右から中央へアイコンが移動し、^00アイコンが中央に来ると行動できます

records.en_auxiliary: The Timeline (TL) displays the turn order of a battle. Allies start from the left, and enemies from the right, and both take action when they reach the center.
records.en: The "Timeline" (TL) displays the turn order of a battle. Allies start from the left and enemies right, but both take action when they reach the center.

records.en_original: The time that it takes for the icon to reach the center (the time it takes for their turn to arrive) is known as "Wait Time" (WT).
records.en_auxiliary: The time that it takes for the icon to reach the center (the time it takes for their turn to arrive) is known as Wait Time (WT).
records.en: The time that it takes for the icon to reach the center (the time it takes for their turn to arrive) is known as "Wait Time" (WT).

records.en_auxiliary: Selecting a skill will show its WT on the TL.
records.en: Selecting a skill will show its WT on the TL.

records.jp: 一部のスキルには、敵のＷＴを延ばして^00行動を遅らせる「ノックバック」の効果が^00あります。敵から攻撃を受ける機会を^00減らせるので、有効的に活用しましょう

records.en_auxiliary: Some skills have a Knockback effect, which lengthens an enemy's WT. Master this mechanic to minimize the damage you take.
records.en: Some skills have a "Knockback" effect, which lengthens an enemy's WT. Mastery of this mechanic will allow you to minimize the damage you take.

records.en_auxiliary: You can change settings including volume, battle difficulty, and text auto-advance from the SETTINGS option.
records.en: The Config option on the Main Menu lets you change sound settings, automatic dialogue, combat speed and more.
